title: PromptDialog
wrapsNative: MonarchDialog (androidx.compose.material3.BasicAlertDialog with a Monarch panel) with a MonarchTextField in its content
summary: Asking for one value is a MonarchDialog with a MonarchTextField in its content, which shows helper and error text. Monarch ships no prompt type.
whenToUse: To ask for one short value in the middle of a task: a name for a new folder, a new title, an email to invite.
whenNotToUse: For more than one or two fields use a Dialog or a screen with a form. For a value the person picks from a list use choice-dialog.
api: @Composable fun MonarchDialog(onDismissRequest: () -> Unit, title: String?, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, description: String? = null, dismissible: Boolean = true, dismissOnClickOutside: Boolean = dismissible, paneTitle: String? = null, actions: (@Composable RowScope.() -> Unit)? = null, content: (@Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit)? = null)

@Composable fun MonarchTextField(value: String, onValueChange: (String) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, label: String? = null, placeholder: String? = null, helperText: String? = null, errorText: String? = null, enabled: Boolean = true, readOnly: Boolean = false, singleLine: Boolean = true, …, keyboardOptions: KeyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions.Default, keyboardActions: KeyboardActions = KeyboardActions.Default, …)

states.name: empty
states.description: The confirm button is disabled until the value is valid.

states.name: invalid
states.description: The field shows errorText, which TalkBack reads with the field.

states.name: keyboard
states.description: The field takes focus when the dialog opens and the keyboard's Done key confirms.

states.name: pending
states.description: The confirm button is loading and dismissal is turned off while the value is saved.

appearance: MonarchDialog in the raised background role; the field is a MonarchTextField with the input border role, the strong accent role when focused and the danger roles for an error. The high-contrast themes resolve the same roles to stronger colors.
platformNotes: The web PromptDialog validates (required, maxLength, url and email types, a validate function), shows an error, stays open while an async save is pending, has a multiline mode and offers usePrompt, which returns a promise. On Android all of this is app code around MonarchDialog: errorText on MonarchTextField, KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = KeyboardType.Email) for the input type, singleLine = false for multiline, and a loading MonarchButton for pending. A promise-style call is a suspendCancellableCoroutine in the app. iOS uses the system alert with a TextField, which closes when a button is tapped.
accessibility: The field has a visible label, which TalkBack reads with its value, helper text and error.
Focus moves to the field when the dialog opens, so the keyboard is ready.
The error is text, not only the red border.
Done on the keyboard confirms, so the value can be entered without reaching for the button.
edgeCases: Request focus after the dialog is shown (LaunchedEffect), not during composition.
Validate on confirm as well as while typing; a pasted value can bypass a length limit set only in onValueChange.
